title: Jugular
summary: JU'GULAR, adjective [Latin jugulum, the neck, either from jugum, a yoke, or from its radical sense, to extend, to join. See Join.] Pertaining to the neck or throat; as the jugular vein. JU'GULAR, noun

inlines.v: JU'GULAR, adjective [Latin jugulum, the neck, either from jugum, a yoke, or from its radical sense, to extend, to join. See Join.] Pertaining to the neck or throat; as the jugular vein. JU'GULAR, noun A large vein of the neck.
